_meta.quantity: each member's regional mean minus observed baseline regional mean, rounded to 3 dp
_meta.cell_method: counts on common valid climate support across all three periods; whole cells intersecting region
_meta.landcover_method: sum existing lc.frac in cells with CWB < 0 / sum lc.frac on common climate support, by class; whole intersecting cells, not clipped region area
_meta.uncertainty: available-member spread, not probability or complete uncertainty
